assumptions: Boundary is PROVISIONAL (provisional_boundaries.geojson, official_boundary=false). All area/ratio values are provisional estimates and MUST be recomputed once the official redline is supplied.
site_area_sqm.precision: provisional boundary, block-level estimate; exact value pending official redline
site_area_sqm.recomputation_trigger: replace geometry/site_boundary.geojson with official redline (official_boundary=true) -> recompute site_area_sqm and all ratios

building_footprint_area_sqm.precision: sum of provisional building footprints; footprint extents are provisional
building_footprint_area_sqm.recomputation_trigger: supply official building footprints -> recompute building_footprint_area_sqm

green_ratio.precision: derived from provisional green_space and site areas; ratio precision limited by both
green_ratio.recomputation_trigger: official redline + official green_space -> recompute green_ratio

public_space_ratio.precision: derived from provisional public_space and site areas
public_space_ratio.recomputation_trigger: official redline + official public_space -> recompute public_space_ratio

floor_area_ratio.reason: Approved FAR controls and official site boundary are not present in the public site package.
floor_area_ratio.precision: unknown; not computable without official FAR controls and approved floor area
floor_area_ratio.recomputation_trigger: approved FAR controls + official boundary supplied -> compute floor_area_ratio

key_area_count.precision: count of provisional key areas from official announcement; count is stable
key_area_count.recomputation_trigger: official key-area designation change -> recompute key_area_count
